_source: All files are from the Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged HF repo (split_files/*), the same source ComfyUI's official Wan 2.2 Fun Control template uses. filename/type/save_path are read directly off the workflow JSON node inputs.
_gpu_note: Two 14B bf16 UNets loaded across the high-noise + low-noise pass (KSamplerAdvanced nodes 96/95 split steps 0-15 / 15-30). bf16 is ~28.6GB per UNet -> use A100 for the bf16 files below.

_fp8_variant_5090.why: For a 32GB card (e.g. RTX 5090) the bf16 pair is too big. Use the fp8_scaled UNets (~14GB each) with the fp8 workflow at FAXevo/workflows/video_wan2_2_fun_control.fp8.api.json (only the two UNet filenames differ; CLIP + VAE are identical to below).

models.name: Wan 2.2 Fun Control 14B — high noise UNet
models.description: Loaded by UNETLoader (node 101), used by KSamplerAdvanced (node 96, steps 0-15, add_noise=enable, return_with_leftover_noise=enable)

models.name: Wan 2.2 Fun Control 14B — low noise UNet
models.description: Loaded by UNETLoader (node 102), used by KSamplerAdvanced (node 95, steps 15-30, add_noise=disable)

models.name: UMT5-XXL text encoder (fp8 scaled)
models.description: Loaded by CLIPLoader (node 90), type=wan. Same file as the TI2V 5B machine. ComfyUI resolves CLIPLoader from both models/clip and models/text_encoders.

models.name: Wan 2.1 VAE
models.description: Loaded by VAELoader (node 92). This workflow correctly uses 'wan_2.1_vae.safetensors' (NOT 'wan2.2_vae.safetensors') — this is intentional and matches ComfyUI's official Wan 2.2 Fun Control template, which pairs the Fun Control 14B UNets with the 2.1 VAE.
